paper.title_en: Flat from AdS: in any even dimension and for any spin
paper.abstract_en: The space of solutions to the free equations of motion for massless fields of arbitrary integer spin in Minkowski spacetime is recovered as a smooth limit of the anti-de Sitter solution space for any even spacetime dimension. The infinite set of boundary data near null infinity that characterise solutions in Minkowski spacetime is obtained from an expansion of the anti-de Sitter source and vev in powers of the cosmological constant. In particular, the source gives rise to the analogue of the gravitational shear tensor, while the vev yields the analogues of the mass and angular-momentum aspects, as well as the subleading infinite tower of boundary data. These identifications are further supported by the branching of the source and vev into representations of the Lorentz algebra identified with the conformal algebra of the celestial sphere.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究 AdS 解空间在宇宙学常数趋于零时平滑退化为 Minkowski 无质量任意整数自旋自由场解空间，并利用边界数据在零类无穷处的展开建立引力剪切张量、质量与角动量方面的类比结构，属于引力理论基础与全息方法交叉的高理论深度工作，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 平直来自 AdS：在任意偶数维与任意自旋
decision.abstract_zh: 在任意偶数时空维度中，Minkowski 时空中任意整数自旋无质量场自由运动方程的解空间被恢复为反 de Sitter 解空间的一个光滑极限。刻画 Minkowski 时空中解的零类无穷附近无穷多边界数据，由反 de Sitter 源和 vev 按宇宙学常数幂次的展开得到。特别地，源给出引力剪切张量的类比物，而 vev 给出质量与角动量方面（aspects）的类比物，以及次领头阶的无穷边界数据塔。这些对应关系进一步得到支持，因为源和 vev 分拆为 Lorentz 代数的表示，而该代数被等同于天球的共形代数。
